## 2. Factory Capabilities & Printing Machinery

Design N Print operates multi-color sheet-fed offset presses and digital prepress suites designed for high-precision registration:

- **Offset Printing Presses:** High-speed multi-color offset presses calibrated for PMS (Pantone Matching System) spot colors and CMYK four-color process work.
- **Computer-to-Plate (CTP) Thermal Platesetters:** High-definition 2400 DPI direct-to-plate imaging ensuring ultra-sharp dot reproduction (1% to 99% tonal curves).
- **Die-Cutting & Creasing:** Automatic high-speed platen die-cutters calibrated to ±0.2mm mechanical tolerance for seamless high-speed packing lines.
- **Finishing Line:** Automatic thermal lamination machines, hydraulic hot foil stamping machines, automated window patchers, folder-gluers for crash-lock bottom cartons, and PUR bookbinders.

## 3. Product Catalog & Technical Print Specifications

### 1. Pharmaceutical Medicine Boxes & Monocartons
- **Substrates:** 250 GSM to 400 GSM ITC Cyber XL, Folding Box Board (FBB), SBS White Back.
- **Features:** High-density 2D GS1 DataMatrix barcodes, Pharmacode, Braille embossing, tamper-evident security reverse tucks.
- **Automated Compatibility:** Calibrated for high-speed automated packaging and blister packing machines.
- **MOQ:** 1,000 units.
- **Turnaround:** 24–48 hours for repeat runs; 3–4 days with new CAD dielines.

### 2. Custom Packaging Boxes & Rigid Gift Boxes
- **Substrates:** 300–450 GSM Art Board, Kraft Liner, 1.5mm to 3.0mm Kappa/Greyboard.
- **Variants:** Top-and-bottom rigid boxes, magnetic flip-open boxes, sliding sleeve drawer boxes, lock-bottom monocartons.
- **Finishes:** Soft-touch velvet lamination, gold/silver foil stamping, raised spot UV, custom die-cut foam/velvet inserts.
- **MOQ:** 500 units for folding cartons; 250 units for luxury rigid boxes.

### 3. Product Catalogues & Corporate Presentation Brochures
- **Cover Stocks:** 250–350 GSM Coated Art Card with thermal matte or gloss lamination.
- **Inside Pages:** 100–170 GSM Coated Art Paper or Maplitho.
- **Binding Types:** PUR Perfect Binding, Saddle Stitching (center wire staple), Hardbound Case Binding, Wire-O.
- **MOQ:** 100 copies.
- **Turnaround:** 48–72 hours.

### 4. Self-Adhesive Sticker Labels & Roll Labels
- **Substrates:** Chromo Paper, Polypropylene (PP), Transparent BOPP, Metallic Silver/Gold Foil Stock.
- **Adhesives:** Permanent hot-melt acrylic adhesive, deep-freeze adhesive, removable adhesive.
- **Finishes:** Gloss/matte UV varnishing, thermal lamination, kiss-die-cutting in sheets or machine rolls.
- **MOQ:** 500 units.

### 5. Cosmetic Item Boxes & Skincare Packaging
- **Substrates:** 350–450 GSM Heavy Virgin Board, MetPET Mirror Board.
- **Features:** Internal locking tabs for glass dropper bottles, holographic foil accents, velvet lamination.
- **MOQ:** 500 units.

### 6. Agrochemical & Pesticide Labels & Packaging
- **Substrates:** Chemical-resistant Poly film, heavyweight water-resistant duplex board.
- **Features:** Fade-resistant lightfast UV inks, multi-color warning labels complying with CIBRC statutory standards.
- **MOQ:** 1,000 units.

### 7. Laminate Mica Display Folders & Sample Books
- **Substrates:** 2.5mm–3.5mm Heavy Duty Industrial Board wrapped in printed 170 GSM paper with reinforced canvas spines.
- **Usage:** Heavy sample folders for Gujarat laminate manufacturers, wooden veneer catalogs, and quartz swatches.
- **MOQ:** 50 folders.

### 8. Ceramic Tile Sample Display Folders
- **Construction:** Heavyweight structural board designed to carry real ceramic tile and sanitaryware swatches without hinge sagging.
- **MOQ:** 50 folders.

### 9. Business Stationery (Visiting Cards, Letterheads, Envelopes)
- **Visiting Cards:** 350–450 GSM Royal Velvet Art Card, Spot UV, Metallic Foil Stamping, Rounded Corners.
- **Letterheads:** 100 GSM Alabaster Bond / Executive Maplitho (inkjet & laser desktop printer compatible).
- **Envelopes:** Peel-and-seal executive envelopes in 9x4 inch, 10x12 inch, and A4 sizes.

### 10. Medical Doctor Files & Hospital Folders
- **Substrates:** 300–400 GSM Heavyweight card with built-in spring clip mechanisms, interior document pockets, and patient prescription charts.
- **MOQ:** 250 units.

## 4. Substrates & Paper Weights (GSM Guide)

| GSM Tier | Substrate Name | Primary Application | Characteristics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **80 – 100 GSM** | Maplitho & Executive Bond | Letterheads, invoices, bill books, manuals | Smooth, uncoated, pen-friendly, non-bleeding |
| **130 – 170 GSM** | Gloss / Matte Art Paper | Brochures, flyer inserts, catalog inner pages | High brightness, sharp halftone dot hold |
| **250 – 300 GSM** | Coated Art Card / Duplex | File folders, catalog covers, tent cards | High crease resistance, clean score lines |
| **350 – 450 GSM** | Virgin SBS / Cyber XL Board | Monocartons, pharma packaging, visiting cards | High stiffness, zero-sag rigidity, food-safe |
| **500 – 600+ GSM** | Kappa Board / European Greyboard | Luxury rigid boxes, sample display binders | 1.5mm to 3.0mm solid crush-proof structure |

---

## 5. Specialty Surface Embellishments

1. **Thermal Velvet (Soft-Touch) Lamination:** Micro-textured matte thermal film providing a rich, rose-petal tactile sensation while protecting against fingerprint smudges.
2. **Raised Spot UV Coating:** High-gloss transparent polymer cured instantly under ultraviolet lamps to create glossy dimensional tactile accents over matte backgrounds.
3. **Hydraulic Hot Foil Stamping:** Heated brass dies pressing metallic foil (Gold, Silver, Rose Gold, Holographic, Copper) onto paper fibers with crisp 0.2mm line precision.
4. **Drip-Off / Hybrid UV Varnish:** Combined matte and gloss reaction varnishing in a single press pass to create striking textured patterns.
5. **Braille Embossing:** Automated tactile Braille dots on pharmaceutical packaging for regulatory compliance.

---

## 6. Pre-Flight File & Artwork Guidelines

To ensure zero production delays and maximum print sharpness:
- **Accepted File Formats:** Print-Ready PDF (PDF/X-1a preferred), CorelDraw (CDR with all text converted to curves), Adobe Illustrator (AI), Layered PSD.
- **Color Mode:** Strictly CMYK (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Key/Black). Convert all RGB photos to CMYK prior to submission.
- **Resolution:** Minimum 300 DPI at 100% actual printed dimensions.
- **Bleed Allowance:** Add 3mm external bleed on all trimming borders. Keep all text, logos, and critical elements at least 4mm inside the finished trim line (Safe Zone).
- **Font Outlines:** Convert all active fonts to outlines / vector curves to prevent font substitution errors during RIP plate imaging.
